title: Follow-ups: not on per-axle fields, empty ones blocked, report without the file
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A per-axle field; a checked follow-up left with no text and no file; a completed report of an inspection whose follow-up (with text and a file) was acknowledged; the ShopCoach brief; and the counting rule to check.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a per-axle field does not offer follow-ups (a verdict is per position, with no single position an instruction would belong to).
2. Confirm a checked follow-up with no text and no file blocks publishing, with the error on the block, while a draft may still be saved.
3. Confirm the customer report shows the follow-up instruction text and its acknowledgement, with who acknowledged it and when, but not the attached file; and confirm neither the instruction nor the acknowledgement reaches the ShopCoach brief (unchanged).
4. Confirm an acknowledgement is not a finding and carries no count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A per-axle field does not offer follow-ups, because a verdict there is recorded per position and there is no single position an instruction would belong to.
  • A checked follow-up with no text and no file blocks publishing, with the error on the block, while a draft may still be saved.
  • The customer report shows the follow-up instruction text and its acknowledgement, with who acknowledged it and when; the attached file does not appear on the report.
  • Neither the instruction nor the acknowledgement reaches the brief sent to ShopCoach.
  • An acknowledgement is not a finding and carries no count.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-10243 (S19 — Conditional follow-up on a checkbox response); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S19; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S19-N1: “A per-axle field will not offer follow-ups. A verdict there is recorded per position and there is no single position an instruction would belong to, which is the reason S17-R6 already gives for the photo rule”
  • S19-N2: “A checked follow-up with no text and no file will block publishing, with the error on the block, as S12-R12 and S12-R13 already do for an empty response label and an empty measurement row name. A draft may still be saved”
  • S19-N3: “The customer report shows the follow-up instruction text and its acknowledgement, with who acknowledged it and when. The attached file does not appear on the report”
  • S19-N4: “Neither reaches the brief sent to ShopCoach. S15-R1 is unchanged”
  • S19-N5: “An acknowledgement is not a finding and carries no count. S5-R17 counts responses”

Amended on 13 October 2026
S19-N3 was rewritten on 5 October 2026 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, read on 13 October 2026): the customer report shows the follow-up instruction text and its acknowledgement (who and when), but not the attached file. The title, preconditions, step 3, the expected results and the quote follow it.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
